run_lrs3_pretrain_split: run the LRS3 preparation script with step 1 to split pretrain labels into a short manifest CSV
run_lrs3_trim_video_audio: run the LRS3 preparation script with step 2 to trim pretrain videos and audio using ffmpeg
run_lrs3_extract_audio: run the LRS3 preparation script with step 3 to extract WAV audio from trainval and test videos
run_lrs3_generate_file_label: run the LRS3 preparation script with step 4 to generate file.list and label.list for all videos
run_lrs3_full_preparation: run the LRS3 preparation script end to end with all four steps to preprocess the full dataset
